calculation.description: Ranks assets higher when recent one-day and five-day volatility-normalized losses are larger, combining a fast shock reversal component with a slower anchor. Volatility uses only trailing observations available at signal time.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive across 2020-2022 (+0.054715, 763 dates), 2023-2024 (+0.040357, 516 dates), and 2025-2027 (+0.038366, 574 dates). Small cross-asset universe; uncertainty interpreted conservatively.
